common:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: polished desktop web application UI design example for Super Planer, a Korean AI game-planning tool.
Create ONE complete desktop screen, wide 16:10 composition around 1920x1200, flat straight-on screenshot, edge-to-edge product UI, no monitor/device mockup, no perspective, no external labels.
Visual system: shadcn/ui light theme, restrained professional product design. White surfaces, zinc-50 background, zinc-900 text, zinc-500 secondary text, zinc-200 1px borders, 8-12px corner radii, subtle shadows, 8px spacing system, clean Lucide-like line icons. Brand primary indigo #4F46E5 sampled from supplied exact logo. Readable Korean typography like Pretendard/Noto Sans KR, precise hierarchy, calm whitespace. No decorative gradients or giant illustrations. Logo text MUST read Super Planer (one n), preserve the supplied original S-shaped workflow icon and wordmark.
Use the SAME example project throughout this UI set: "달빛 우체국", a cozy game delivering letters in a small forest village. All visible UI text Korean, except exact logo and conventional shortcuts/AI.
Reference inputs: first supplied image is the original logo rasterized from the user's SVG, preserve its identity. Sketch images supply information hierarchy only, replace hand drawing with finished shadcn-style UI. Do not draw orange numbered annotations.

screens.prompt: Screen 1: idea entry. Follow sketch 1: big centered original logo above a large prompt composer. This is the empty start of a real app inspired by prompt-first v0 / Lovable / Replit UX. At top left a small "워크스페이스" breadcrumb; top right small "내 프로젝트" ghost button and circular J avatar. Center content width roughly 760px with abundant empty space. Logo around 250px wide at y=250. Heading below "어떤 게임을 만들고 싶나요?" then subtitle "떠오른 아이디어를 적어주세요. 질문을 나누며 기획을 구체화해요." Main textarea white bordered card, 760x190, visible example typed prompt "작은 숲속 마을에서 편지를 배달하는\n따뜻한 힐링 게임을 만들고 싶어." Bottom inside composer: paperclip icon "참고 자료" on left, right indigo submit button with up arrow and label "기획 시작". Below show tiny Enter-key hint and three compact outline inspiration chips "힐링 시뮬레이션", "스토리 어드벤처", "캐주얼 퍼즐". Near bottom quiet three-step progress "01 아이디어 → 02 질문과 답변 → 03 기획 완성". Clean product screenshot, excellent central composition.

Screen 2: guided Socratic questions after entering prompt. Follow sketch 2 with centered original logo and vertical stack of prompt summary then question component. Top minimal app bar same as entry, back "이전으로" left, avatar J right. Main content centered width 800px. Logo smaller around 210px wide near top y=160. Muted compact prompt summary card with icon and text "작은 숲속 마을에서 편지를 배달하는 힐링 게임". Beneath: active question card, white shadcn Card, generous padding. Top progress label "질문 2 / 5" left, "플레이 경험" small badge right, 40% indigo thin progress bar. Heading "플레이어가 어떤 기분을 느끼면 좋을까요?" supporting sentence "가장 가까운 답을 고르거나, 직접 적어주세요." Three full-width radio answer cards, each with outline icon, title and short description: "편안한 휴식" selected with indigo border/pale indigo background and checked radio, "이야기 속 몰입", "작은 성취의 즐거움". Below a labeled text input "직접 입력" with placeholder "원하는 경험을 자유롭게 적어주세요". Bottom previous outline button and indigo "다음 질문" button. Small helper below "정답은 없어요. 나중에 언제든 바꿀 수 있어요." All content readable, no sidebar yet, thoughtful and calm.
Additional reference: third image is the already approved first screen in this same UI set; match its typography, border treatment, indigo buttons and overall light theme.

Screen 3: generated project workspace in node workflow view. Follow LEFT panel of sketch 3, using full desktop canvas. Persistent 230px white left sidebar original Super Planer logo at top 170px wide, outline "+ 새 프로젝트" button, section "프로젝트", selected project "달빛 우체국" pale indigo row, another "숲속 카페", bottom settings and avatar J. Main top header shows breadcrumb "프로젝트 / 달빛 우체국", saved green dot "저장됨", outline "공유", indigo prominent "기획서 생성" button at upper right. Below large project heading "달빛 우체국" and pencil icon (project name); description "숲속 마을에 편지를 전하며 마음을 잇는 힐링 어드벤처" (project description). Tabs "워크플로우" selected and "기획서", with progress "결정 완료 3 / 6". Main remaining area light gray dotted infinite canvas, n8n-like branching Bezier connections, handles on left/right of node cards. Six or seven deliberately arranged readable planning cards: root "게임 컨셉" at left, branches "핵심 플레이" top-middle, "세계관과 스토리" middle, "아트 방향" bottom-middle, right "성장과 보상", "등장인물". White 220x150 cards with icon, title, 1-2 line description, status Badge. "게임 컨셉", "세계관과 스토리", "아트 방향" status green "결정 완료"; "핵심 플레이" indigo "진행 중" selected indigo outline; "성장과 보상", "등장인물" gray "검토 전". EVERY card has a tiny expand icon in upper right. Include tiny "대화 4" and footer "결정 확정" / undo icon as appropriate. A small illustrative forest thumbnail in art card is allowed, no huge art. Bottom canvas zoom controls "- 100% +" left, minimap right. This must be a practical dense app UI not diagram on presentation board. Do not use number annotations.
Additional reference: third image is the already approved first screen in this same UI set; match its typography, border treatment, indigo buttons and overall light theme.

Screen 4: workflow node expanded into agent conversation. Follow MIDDLE panel of sketch 3. SAME persistent sidebar and header/project title as workflow screen: Super Planer logo, projects, selected "달빛 우체국"; description "숲속 마을에 편지를 전하며 마음을 잇는 힐링 어드벤처"; upper right primary "기획서 생성". Dotted workflow canvas remains visible behind. CENTER of canvas a tall expanded node card 640px wide and 760px tall, white with subtle strong shadow and indigo top border, connector ports and branching lines visible at either side connecting to collapsed nodes. This is an INLINE EXPANDED NODE, not a modal and not a separate unrelated sidebar. Expanded header icon "핵심 플레이", indigo "진행 중" badge, collapse icon and more menu top right. Description "편지 배달의 재미와 하루의 흐름을 정해요." Main content conversational turns with small AI icon and user J avatar. AI: "편지를 배달하는 과정에서 어떤 재미가 있으면 좋을까요?" user pale indigo bubble: "마을을 탐험하고 주민의 이야기를 듣고 싶어." AI: "탐험과 대화를 중심으로 하루의 흐름을 잡아볼게요." Then concise outline "편지 받기 → 마을 탐험 → 주민과 대화 → 편지 전달". A sources preview gallery with two small lovely warm forest-game thumbnails, link cards captioned "마을 탐험 레퍼런스" and "주민과의 대화", tiny external-link icons, slider indicator. Decision summary inset "결정 사항" text "배달 한 번에 10~15분 · 탐험과 대화 중심". Bottom textarea "이 결정에 대해 더 이야기해보세요..." with paperclip/send, below outline "되돌리기" and primary "결정 확정". Card's text should feel spacious and readable. Background other nodes subdued but clearly connected; same design language as workspace.
Additional reference: third image is the already approved first screen in this same UI set; match its typography, border treatment, indigo buttons and overall light theme.

Screen 5: generated planning document preview. Follow RIGHT panel of sketch 3, same workspace and original logo. SAME 230px sidebar projects selected "달빛 우체국". Top breadcrumb "프로젝트 / 달빛 우체국", saved status and upper right indigo "기획서 생성" still visible (regeneration), alongside outline "내보내기". Project header title "달빛 우체국", description "숲속 마을에 편지를 전하며 마음을 잇는 힐링 어드벤처". Tabs "워크플로우" and selected "기획서". Below split document viewer: narrow 200px outline/TOC on left with "목차", links "프로젝트 개요" selected, "핵심 플레이", "세계관과 스토리", "아트 방향", "성장과 보상". Right 850px document area with toolbar "미리보기" selected / "Markdown", small version badge "v1.0" and "결정 사항 6개 반영", download icon. Scrollable off-white viewer contains a white portrait document page with fine border, ample margins. At top tiny eyebrow "GAME DESIGN DOCUMENT", big "달빛 우체국", subtitle "숲속 마을에서 전하는 작은 마음들", small metadata "기획 초안 · v1.0". A full-width short beautiful cozy forest post office concept art banner. Then heading "01 프로젝트 개요" and two lines in Korean explaining a cozy adventure delivering letters and hearing villagers' stories. Three small metadata fields "장르: 힐링 어드벤처", "플랫폼: PC", "플레이: 싱글 플레이". Heading "02 핵심 플레이" with clean four-step horizontal loop "편지 받기 → 마을 탐험 → 주민과 대화 → 편지 전달", below heading "03 세계관과 스토리" with brief text. A small source badge "핵심 플레이 · 결정 완료" in document margin. Polished actual Markdown rendered preview, sufficient readable text without excessive tiny paragraphs. Entire screen visible, no cropping of app frame.
Additional reference: third image is the already approved first screen in this same UI set; match its typography, border treatment, indigo buttons and overall light theme.
